one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-11-18 to 2026-12-17. AMAT reported on 2026-11-12, so no company print falls inside. Scheduled: Nvidia FQ3 results this week (the AI-capex read; 24/7 Wall St flagged it as the near-term test), SEMI's year-end equipment forecast at SEMICON Japan in mid-December, the December FOMC, and Micron FQ1 around 2026-12-17 (likely after the close, at the window edge). Unscheduled: Democratic data-center/AI policy headlines before the new Congress (the Nov-5 rout came from this) and China export-rule news. Post-earnings drift after a guide just below consensus ($11.1B vs $11.41B) and ten target cuts is mildly negative, while the 53% drawdown from the June high leaves room for a reversal; the two roughly cancel. I use a near-symmetric lognormal around $350 at monthly vol 64%/3.5 = 18.3%.

reasoning: Skeptic lane. The stock is 53% below its June high: forward P/E fell from 49x to ~21x (TIKR) after the Nov-5 post-midterm chip rout (Democratic AI/data-center crackdown, Ives estimate), and a Q1 guide of $11.1B just under the $11.41B consensus brought ten target cuts (Jefferies $770 -> $580, UBS $695 -> $640, Needham $470) and a Summit downgrade on cleanroom limits and litho budget share. CEO Dickerson sold 71.7k shares at $594 in June; the $252M BIS export settlement is closed (DOJ/SEC closed). Against that, results are strong (Q4 revenue +53%, SSG +64%), management's quarterly guides were met or beaten in all four recent quarters (median +2.1%), and ASML/SK hynix/Samsung all describe supply short of demand into 2028. Build: CY2027 WFE +28% on the SEMI series (2pt under the CEO for the cleanroom limit), slowing to +6%/+4% as memory and policy risks bite, x 18.8% SSG share (exit-rate gains offset by China and litho), SSG margin 38% fading to 36%. This sits 5.6% under consensus FY2027 revenue and ~20% under consensus FY2028 EPS ($24.07), mostly from the slower CY2028-29 WFE path. Valued at 19.7x (k-rule) on NTM EPS ~$18.8, a 3.95% FCF yield and a mid-cycle cross-check, the research target (12m) is ~$364, ~4% above the last close: the de-rating already prices a slowdown, so the skeptic view lands near the price, not far below it. Downside (P10 ~$220): WFE -20% vs base, -0.6pt share, -5pt margin, ~14x. Upside (P90 ~$505): WFE +10%, +0.4pt share, +2pt margin, ~24x. Research limits: several pages rate-limited (Nasdaq transcript, FourWeekMBA, Trefis); Twelve Data estimates/insider endpoints not in plan.

model_inputs.structure_note: Driver-led annual set: WFE x SSG share x SSG margin, AGS and Other revenue; value carried by a P/E leg (0.45) and an FCF-yield leg (0.30, 40% of the P/E + FCF weight per the tech FCF rule) on the build's own NTM figures at the horizon, plus a normalized mid-cycle EPS x through-cycle P/E cross-check (0.25, playbook 0.2-0.4; computed in Python from the engine's FY2028 revenue, net cash and shares, not driver-linked). No DCF (not a neocloud), no SOTP: SSG and AGS share one cycle and customer base.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) exit FCF yield 3.95% (exit P/E stated on FCF at peer conversion) vs ~3.2% from shrinking the peer NTM-equivalent yield: ~+7% to the research target (12m); (2) WFE path vs SEMI straight line to $227B in 2029: ~+6-7%. The set is annual, not quarterly (forecaster round; the modeler builds the quarter set). Only 4 genuine peers carry gate-ready NTM figures (ASML, Tokyo Electron, ASM International, Kokusai not sourced in this rerun). Besi stake increase by accelerated share purchase (size undisclosed) is not in net debt; probability of a large debt deal is under 20% (net cash, A-grade balance sheet). Research was limited by rate limits (Nasdaq transcript, Trefis, FourWeekMBA unreadable).
